summary: Full end-to-end test of 'Inglés para Hostelería' MVP. Backend: created pytest suite (10 tests, 9 pass) covering categories, category detail, lesson availability, guest CRUD/progress persistence and 404/422 handling. Frontend: full flow validated on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): Landing -> Onboarding (guest created in backend) -> Home -> Category -> Lesson (intro, phrases, dialogue+translation toggle, 5 flashcards, 3 exercises, 5 quiz questions) -> Completion. Persistence verified: guest doc had 5 flashcard_interactions and completed_lessons [{taking-an-order, 4, 5}]. Refresh on /home, mid-lesson refresh, direct deep links, and unavailable-lesson page all work. ONE CRITICAL CONTENT/LOGIC BUG: word_ordering questions can never be answered correctly (answer contains trailing '?' but words array does not), so max quiz score is 4/5.

critical.issue: word_ordering items are unsolvable: ex_order_ready words=['ready','you','Are','to','order'] but answer='Are you ready to order?'; q_order_anything words=['else','anything','like','Would','you'] but answer='Would you like anything else?'. Frontend compares picked.join(' ') === q.answer strictly, so the correct order is always graded Incorrect. Verified in UI: exercise-2 and quiz-3 return 'Incorrecto' with the right word order; quiz max score is 4/5. Fix by either adding punctuation to the last word / removing '?' from answer, or normalizing punctuation in QuestionCard.evaluate().

ui_bugs.issue: Correct word order graded as incorrect (see backend critical item). Strict string equality against answer containing '?'.

Duplicate data-testid values on /home: category-card-general, category-card-restaurant, category-card-bar each appear twice (Recommended section + Explore grid). Breaks strict-mode selectors in automation; recommended cards should have a distinct prefix e.g. recommended-card-{slug}.

issues: Horizontal page overflow: document.scrollWidth=397 vs clientWidth=390. Situation rows (Category.js SituationRow) extend ~7px past viewport; long titles like 'Allergies & dietary requirements' don't shrink because the inner 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap' wrapper lacks min-w-0, so truncate never applies. Add min-w-0 to that wrapper (and allow the title to wrap on small screens).
Low contrast for eyebrow 'INGLÉS REAL PARA HOSTELERÍA' and the 'Sin registro. Empiezas en segundos.' line over the photographic hero background; consider a stronger overlay or higher-opacity text.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix word_ordering data/grading so the correct order is accepted (seed_content.py answers include '?' not present in words, or normalize punctuation/whitespace in QuestionCard.evaluate).
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on /category/{slug} situation rows (add min-w-0 to inner title wrapper in Category.js).
Rename recommended category card test ids on Home to avoid duplicate data-testid values.
Optional: improve hero text contrast on landing.
critical_code_review_comments: QuestionCard grading uses strict string equality for word_ordering; should normalize case/whitespace/punctuation to avoid content-authoring traps.
Lesson.js is ~730 lines with 8 components; consider splitting steps into separate files.
getLesson/getCategories failures are only handled via .finally() — a network error leaves an empty/'not available' state without any error UI or retry.
AppContext swallows guest-creation failures (console.error only); user silently loses progress tracking with no toast/feedback.
Backend guest endpoints have no rate/size limits and accept arbitrary learning_item_id/situation_slug (no validation against existing content).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows pass; word_ordering grading + mobile overflow fail)

seed_data_creation: Created transient test guests via POST /api/guests (test flashcard id TEST_phrase_1) plus 2 guests from UI onboarding runs (e2b5fec4..., 17b8ddb2...). No content data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py). test_lesson_taking_an_order asserts word_ordering words match answer tokens — it will pass once the '?' mismatch is fixed. Frontend flow fully scripted: onboarding testids workplace-option-{id}/goal-option-{id}, lesson steps intro-start-btn -> phrases-next-btn -> dialogue-next-btn -> flashcard/flashcard-knew x5 -> exercise-{i}/quiz-{i} with -option-{i}/-input/-check-btn/-continue-btn -> completion-score. Note duplicate category-card testids on /home (use .first).
rca_of_the_issue: word_ordering: seed answers are full sentences with terminal '?' while the words array contains only unpunctuated tokens; Lesson.js QuestionCard evaluates ok = picked.map(w).join(' ') === q.answer, so the built string can never equal the answer. Reproduce: /lesson/taking-an-order -> exercises -> question 3 -> tap Are/you/ready/to/order -> Comprobar -> 'Incorrecto'. Same for quiz question 4; completion score capped at 4/5.
